A Legacy Born from the Abyss Inspired by the pioneers of deep-sea exploration, the Heritus Descendens takes its name from the Latin word for “descending”—a tribute to the fearless divers who push the limits of the deep. Just as the ocean demands respect and precision, this timepiece is meticulously engineered to withstand 200 meters of water resistance, ensuring unwavering reliability in the most unforgiving environments. Strength Beneath the Surface Every detail of the Heritus Descendens is designed for the modern explorer. The sapphire crystal, nearly as hard as the ocean’s pressure itself, offers unparalleled durability, while the bright lume ceramic bezel insert ensures precise tracking of time under any condition. At its heart beats the NH35A automatic movement, a powerhouse of mechanical precision, mirroring the relentless pulse of the tides. A Design Forged by the Sea The dial, a deep black abyss, contrasts sharply with bold C3 luminescent indices and hands, evoking the bioluminescent creatures that guide divers in the darkest depths. The stainless steel case and bracelet, brushed to perfection, reflect the raw power and timeless beauty of the sea. Whether descending into the depths or standing at the water’s edge, the Heritus Descendens is a symbol of mastery over time and tide. Answer the Deep’s Call The ocean is vast, mysterious, and ever-changing—just like time itself. The Heritus Descendens is not merely a watch; it is a companion for those who dare to explore, conquer, and endure. Will you answer the deep’s call?
